source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 6. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.

title.en: The adhan: the call to prayer

topic: Its words and how to answer it

learn.en: The adhan tells everyone that it is time for one of the five prayers. The person who calls it is the muʾadhdhin.
learn.title: Time to pray!

learn.en: The adhan is short, but it holds the whole message of Islam: Allah is the Greatest, He is One, Muhammad ﷺ is His Messenger — come to prayer, come to success!
learn.title: The message of Islam

learn.en: At Fajr only, the muʾadhdhin adds twice: “Prayer is better than sleep.”
learn.title: Only at Fajr

learn.en: When you hear the adhan, repeat what the muʾadhdhin says. (Bukhari 611)
learn.title: Answer the adhan

learn.en: But when he says “ḥayya ʿala ṣ-ṣalāh” and “ḥayya ʿala l-falāḥ”, you say: “There is no power and no strength except with Allah.” (Muslim 385)
learn.title: The special answer
learn.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
learn.tr: lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

words.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ
words.en: I testify that there is no god but Allah
I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
There is no god but Allah
Prayer is better than sleep (Fajr only)

words.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
words.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah
words.tr: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

quiz.en: What is added in the Fajr adhan?
What do we say when we hear “ḥayya ʿala ṣ-ṣalāh”?
opts: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

quiz.en: True or false? We repeat the other words of the adhan after the muʾadhdhin.

think.q: Next time you hear the adhan, can you answer every phrase?
think.a: Repeat each phrase — and at the two “ḥayya ʿalā…” say lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

parents.summary: The adhan calls us to prayer five times a day. We repeat its words, except the two “come to…” phrases, where we say lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. Fajr adds “prayer is better than sleep”.

try.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
try.translit: lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh
try.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah

parents.tip: Pause whatever you are doing at the adhan and answer it together.
